changelog: The emergency gesture works with any figurine, even one not paired yet: what counts is the rhythm, five taps about 3 seconds apart, and the boot screen now reminds parents how to do it. In the Wi-Fi window that opens on Cucù's own network only the Wi-Fi pages appear, never the whole app (it happened on Android after choosing to stay on a network without Internet), and on Android the page for using Cucù without Wi-Fi points to 10.42.0.1.
